title: The Blue Book briefing folders of 160 remote viewing successes

tellings.quote: we had What's called the Blue Book the blue briefing books it was two books two folders with 160 successes in it

plain: Joe McMoneagle says he worked in a US military programme on "remote viewing", the idea that a person can describe a distant place or target using only the mind. He says that from about 1978 into the 1990s, the unit, based at Fort Meade in Maryland, kept two blue briefing folders it called the Blue Book, holding 160 of its successes. If true, it would mean the programme believed it had a solid record that it showed to officials.
